_about: Pangrella's own races, from the export's own words (fixtures/pangrella-campaign.json).
The continents name the species — 'Winged: Kaelinorans, Flightless: Kyrexi' on
(flightless)' on Korvathyr — and the six PEOPLE entries are cultures of them: a
Nahyrin is a Kaelinoran, a Zhilakai a Kyrexi, the Khra'gix, Khy'vyr and Nirkor are
Valtorian nomads. The Korvu, 'descended from the earliest Kyrexi migrants', have
avian wings, talons and echolocation in their own entry, so they are a body of
their own. Offered by the forge in this world only (`world`), beside the Core seven
when the table allows them. Anatomy is the eidolon's evolutions, free; nothing here
is a number the Race Builder or the catalogue did not set.

races.name: Korvu
races.description: Korvu have avian-like wings and bodies, four limbs ending in sharp talons, and enhanced echolocation. Descended from the earliest Kyrexi migrants; matrilineal clans herding winged beasts across the Pangrellan grasslands, master craftsmen in auramancy.

races.name: Kaelinoran
races.description: The winged people of Kaelinora — 'Winged: Kaelinorans, Flightless: Kyrexi'. Clan chiefs and settlers who founded Elyrielle and Torvathys after the Great Shattering; the spires of Mirabalos are built in their style.

heritages.name: Nahyrin
heritages.summary: Kaelinoran Wastes nomads; honoured guests of the settled powers, trading partners with the Korvu.

races.name: Kyrexi
races.description: The flightless people of Kaelinora, whose great migration of 1212 altered Vedrazhia's borders. Huts of their making stand beside the winged spires of Mirabalos.

heritages.name: Zhilakai
heritages.summary: Flightless refugees from Kyrexi, founded by Aethonir, an exile who found peace in flightlessness; revered in Pangrellan society.

races.name: Korvathyran
races.description: The winged people of Korvathyr, ten million of them by the continent's count — Kalixiri's winged stonework is theirs.

races.name: Valtorian
races.description: The flightless people of Korvathyr's forests and mountain ranges — the Pillars of Korvu — scholars in Zhilorin's castes and nomads on the steppes.

heritages.name: Khra'gix
heritages.summary: Valtorian nomads of the sacred ranges and Pangrellan oases; resonant crystal smiths, dependent on the settled powers for trade.

heritages.name: Khy'vyr
heritages.summary: Ancient Valtorian wanderers of Korvathyr's central highlands; a matriarchal clan-confederacy, tolerated outcasts, weavers of silk and wind-song.

heritages.name: Nirkor
heritages.summary: Ancient Valtorian nomads ranging the Pangrellan steppes and Kelvaxian deserts; herders, occasional raiders, master craftsmen of Valtorian crystalwork.

races.name: Kelvaxian
races.description: The subterranean people of Korvathyr, five million strong; merchants who wield hidden influence over Zhilorin's trade, builders of the Kelvaxian canals.
